name: dentalmarket-functions
description: Server-side triggers this app cannot safely run client-side — currently just the one: pushing a real FCM notification to the admin's device the moment a user submits or resubmits an identity verification. Sending to a specific device needs Admin SDK credentials, which can never live in the Android APK (anyone could decompile it and impersonate the server) — that's the whole reason this directory exists.
